source.quote_free_summary: In Couples divisions other than Mixed-Role, a pair is one male leader and one female follower; only momentary role reversals are accepted.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile must enforce the male-leader / female-follower pair in all Couples divisions except Mixed-Role, tolerating only momentary role reversals.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: gender collection, columns, migrations, role-lock enforcement, UI.
interpretation_notes: Needs gender data DanceFlow does not collect (OD27-DF-0002 decides whether and how). 'Momentary' is not defined in the text read. How a division is flagged Mixed-Role is not modelled.
